run_parallel_inference: run a binary NUM_GPUS times in parallel across GPU subranges for multi-GPU inference
split_data_across_gpus: split a data range across multiple GPUs and launch subprocesses for each GPU independently
log_subprocess_output: capture and log stdout from each parallel subprocess in real time or buffered mode
review_process_in_parallel: review the process_in_parallel function that spawns GPU-bound subprocesses and collects pickled results
refactor_process_in_parallel: refactor process_in_parallel to use Python 3 compatible file type checking instead of cPickle
